metadata.description: React/TypeScript frontend enforcement harness for Claude Code -- 82 hooks, 41 skills, 8 agents, 5 routines

plugins.name: frontend-skills
plugins.description: React/TypeScript frontend enforcement harness. 82 wired hooks (85 scripts) enforce patterns on every edit. 41 skills from TDD through CI-green PR. 21 LLM failure modes enforced (7 Karpathy single-agent + 14 MAST multi-agent, Cemri et al. NeurIPS 2025). OWASP + STRIDE + snyk/bun audit. Core Web Vitals perf gate. Worktree isolation + branch safety. Agent-browser integration (~91% token reduction). 9 agents (3-hat plan review + karpathy reference), 5 routines. Opus 4.7 tuned. POSIX-friendly.
